properties.name: xarch.mq.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for the xarch RabbitMQ starter.

properties.name: xarch.mq.producer.auto-declare
properties.description: Auto-declare exchanges/queues/bindings at startup.

properties.name: xarch.mq.producer.publisher-confirms
properties.description: Enable AMQP publisher confirms for at-least-once semantics.

properties.name: xarch.mq.producer.publisher-returns
properties.description: Enable AMQP publisher returns to detect unroutable messages.

properties.name: xarch.mq.producer.default-exchange
properties.description: Default exchange to publish to when not specified.

properties.name: xarch.mq.producer.mandatory
properties.description: Whether messages must be routable; unroutable messages trigger a return.

properties.name: xarch.mq.consumer.concurrency
properties.description: Default concurrent consumers per listener.

properties.name: xarch.mq.consumer.max-concurrency
properties.description: Default max concurrent consumers per listener.

properties.name: xarch.mq.consumer.prefetch
properties.description: Default prefetch count per consumer.

properties.name: xarch.mq.consumer.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether listener containers start automatically.

properties.name: xarch.mq.consumer.retry-max-attempts
properties.description: Max retry attempts before sending to DLQ.

properties.name: xarch.mq.consumer.retry-initial-interval
properties.description: Initial retry back-off interval in milliseconds.

properties.name: xarch.mq.consumer.retry-multiplier
properties.description: Back-off multiplier for retries.

properties.name: xarch.mq.consumer.retry-max-interval
properties.description: Max retry back-off interval in milliseconds.

properties.name: xarch.mq.dlx.enabled
properties.description: Auto-declare the dead-letter exchange and queue.

properties.name: xarch.mq.dlx.exchange
properties.description: Dead-letter exchange name.

properties.name: xarch.mq.dlx.queue
properties.description: Dead-letter queue name.

properties.name: xarch.mq.dlx.routing-key
properties.description: Routing key for binding the DLQ to the DLX.

properties.name: xarch.mq.dlx.message-ttl
properties.description: Time-to-live (ms) for messages in the DLQ.

properties.name: xarch.mq.dlx.max-length
properties.description: Max number of messages retained in the DLQ (0 = unlimited).

properties.name: xarch.mq.tracing.enabled
properties.description: Inject OpenTelemetry trace context into AMQP headers (requires xarch-tracing).
